Name: Network Assessment BGP Reader
Description: Read-only BGP state for Cloud Network Assessment: POST actions that return data and change nothing. Every action was checked against the Microsoft Learn Azure permissions reference for Networking on 2026-10-25; to re-check against your tenant before az role definition create, run az provider operation show --namespace Microsoft.Network. AssignableScopes must be set to the scopes you assess by whoever creates the role; the sample subscription id here is fictional.
